messages:
anya: heads up — during the QA load run we got a bunch of short 1–2 req spikes that tripped org-level token buckets and caused client retries. thinking about a small change: add a short 'microburst_grace_ms' so token buckets allow tiny spikes without draining credits.
ryan: do you have numbers? how short are these spikes?
maria: saw 250–700ms spikes, ~12 reqs each. capacity 60 but refill logic made them look like sustained.
anya: yes. probe attached: some client libs fire retries in bursts and our leaky bucket treats them as sustained -> rejections. Proposal: keep long-term bucket as-is, add a microburst reservoir with N tokens that is refilled every M ms. default: 8 tokens, window 500ms.
samir: interesting. how does this interact with dedicated accounts/sla? we want deterministic latency.
anya: dedicated gets smaller grace by default (2 tokens) and can be disabled per-customer. hosted free tiers use larger grace to reduce noise.
jess: UX question — if we add this, how do we show it in console? feature flag? add timeline & per-route metric?
anya: propose 'allow-microbursts' toggle on quota policy page and new metric 'quota.burst.consume_rate' histogram. Also dashboard tile: 'recent microburst events' with labels org,key,route.
ryan: can you sketch config? would love a simple operator API.
anya: config example:
```yaml
quota_policy:
  token_bucket:
    capacity: 60
    refill_per_sec: 20
  microburst_reservoir:
    tokens: 8
    window_ms: 500
    refill_strategy: periodic
    jitter_pct: 10
```
samir: what about backoff when microburst is exhausted? immediate fallback to normal bucket or soft-throttle?
anya: soft-throttle: when microburst empty, mark request's response header X-Quota-Used-Microburst and apply short 200ms 429-after window before full rejection. avoids client hammer.
devops-bot: [deploy] started rollout of quota-microburst v1 to canaries
ryan: observability: add gauge 'quota.microburst.available' and summary 'microburst.recover_ms' for p50/p95.
maria: also add unit tests simulating concurrent retries from our node proxy — they found a lot of flakey reproducible rejections.
jess: rollout plan? feature flag + 2-week canary in prod + partners opt-in?
anya: exactly. canary on 5% orgs, enable by route for initial week, monitor errors and cost delta, then widen. I'll open a PR with dashboard defs and runbook.
samir: fine by me. one ask — add audit log entries when microburst kicks in (for privacy reasons log only counts not payload).
anya: agreed. will add admin audit event 'quota.microburst_applied' with org,key,route,count.
ryan: sounds good. I'll pick up the metrics + telemetry plumbing.
maria: thanks. QA will re-run spike tests tomorrow afternoon.
jess: :thumbsup:
